creative_brief.emotional_promise: Wake the moon: one gentle rock transforms a protective curled dragon into a bright castle-bearing crescent.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A simple one-piece Spark talisman needs no booklet; one double-sided card keeps inventory and promise on the front, then the complete interaction, reset, troubleshooting, care, and safety together on the back.
creative_brief.physical_format: Double-sided 6 x 4 inch landscape owner card with safe margins and no bleed-dependent content.
teaching_arc: Recognize the sleeping-dragon promise and one-piece inventory.
Choose a clear, level, hard desk and begin on the long dragon edge.
Tip the upper-right edge clockwise with one gentle action.
Identify the straight castle rest and crescent reveal from exact product views.
Reverse the rock to reset, then consult concise troubleshooting, care, and safety cues.
typography: Bitstream Vera Bold for display, action headings, and labels
Bitstream Vera for instructions and supporting copy
creative_brief.visual_motif: A night-sky owner card pairs a vector crescent with exact gold-and-ink Made renders; rounded panels echo the rocking arc, while numbered state cards make the physical cycle read without color.

findings: The first page-2 before/after strip cropped through both exact product states, hiding their upper silhouettes.
The cover adjective quiet implied unsupported physical performance from digital-only evidence.
Small pale supporting copy had marginal intended-size and grayscale contrast.
Abstract action icons needed a stronger orientation link to the exact product states.
resolved_changes: Rebuilt the before/after strip as two complete exact-product state views labeled DRAGON REST and CASTLE REST.
Replaced quiet with gentle, increased supporting-copy contrast and size, and shortened bottom-panel copy to preserve safe spacing.
Kept numbered REST, ROCK, and REVEAL panels while binding them to labeled exact state views and an explicit clockwise cue.
